response.sql:
WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    Track.Bytes, 
    Track.Milliseconds, 
    Track.MediaTypeId, 
    MediaType.Name
  FROM Track
  JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
  WHERE Track.Bytes > 10323804
),
media_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    Name,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId, Name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg
  FROM media_averages
)
SELECT 
  m.Name,
  m.avg_bytes_per_ms,
  m.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg
FROM media_averages m
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
WHERE m.avg_bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: The 'average bytes per millisecond' is computed as the average of per-track ratios (bytes ÷ milliseconds for each track), not as an aggregate ratio (sum of all bytes ÷ sum of all milliseconds).

alternatives.interpretation: The 'average bytes per millisecond' for each media type is computed as an aggregate ratio: (total bytes in media type) ÷ (total milliseconds in media type).

WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    Track.Bytes, 
    Track.Milliseconds, 
    Track.MediaTypeId, 
    MediaType.Name
  FROM Track
  JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
  WHERE Track.Bytes > 10323804
),
media_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    Name,
    CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(SUM(Milliseconds) AS DECIMAL) AS bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId, Name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg
  FROM media_aggregates
)
SELECT 
  m.Name,
  m.bytes_per_ms,
  m.bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg
FROM media_aggregates m
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
WHERE m.bytes_per_ms > o.overall_avg
